claims: The 98th Academy Awards were on March 15, 2026.
Ryan Coogler won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay for writing Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler's Oscar win for Best Original Screenplay marks his first Oscar win.
Sinners received 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners won Best Actor for Michael B. Jordan at the 98th Academy Awards.
